prompt: Some people believe that children are given too much free time. They feel that this time should be used to do more school work. How do you think children should spend their free time. Reason and examples....
essay:
Nowadays, many people debate whether children are given too much leisure time or if those hours should be dedicated to additional schoolwork. In my opinion, young people need a balanced routine that divides their schedule between academic tasks and recreational activities to foster both discipline and independence.

To begin with, how children manage their free time should depend on their age and personal development. Younger children benefit greatly from unstructured play, while older students require a daily schedule that balances homework with hobbies. For instance, playing educational puzzles sharpens cognitive skills, whereas engaging in sports or video games offers stress relief. Parents should help establish structured routines to ensure these recreational activities do not interfere with academic growth.

Furthermore, free time allows children to pursue their individual interests and build essential social skills. When students engage in passion-driven pursuits—such as learning a musical instrument or joining community groups—they build confidence and learn how to interact within society. Giving children autonomy over part of their day encourages self-reliance and teaches them how to set personal goals.

In conclusion, allocating time for both academic work and leisure is vital for a child's future success. When parents guide their children to manage their time effectively, it promotes lifelong learning and overall well-being.
